name: Da Ming International Holdings Limited
summary: Da Ming International Holdings Limited, established in 2007 and headquartered in Wuxi, is a subsidiary of Ally Good Group Limited that processes, distributes and sells stainless and carbon steel products in China and worldwide. Its range covers high-strength, wear-resistant, duplex, heat-resistant and nickel-based alloy steels, among others. It also trades metal materials and fixed assets, serving customers in machinery, petrochemicals, automotive, construction and renewable energy.
